not_a_result: No held-out chat confirmation has run. Candidate/baseline selection is provisional. Do not promote this draft without completing development on an eligible host.
preflight: Must be eligible and no more than120seconds old when starting. All model arms independently retain host counters. A failed CPU gate invalidates qualification; do not drop/retry traces.
quality: Every request token IDs, text, prompt length and task-correctness classification must match primary native baseline, with zero failures. Report absolute strict copy-task accuracy, including incorrect answers and EOS/cap finishes.
uncertainty: 10000 fixed-seed hierarchical paired bootstrap replicates; sessions then whole paired traces. Require latency and throughput thresholds in every session and corresponding confidence bounds. No optional stopping, added traces or relaxed thresholds.
scope: Chat-template-framed synthetic long-input/short-input burst only, one Qwen0.5B CPU artifact. Conventional admission heuristic; no general competitor or base-model-quality win. Earlier raw-completion study remains failed.
failure_policy: Retain and report every result and gate failure. New prompts/framing do not repair the failed original study. CPU contention discovered after earlier development means no existing chat measurement establishes a clean held-out win.
status_notes: Unexecuted four-thread draft retained. Pinned one-thread feasibility is separate development. Refresh all source/runner/configuration hashes and finish baseline selection before freezing any executable protocol.
